build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template with a ball, horizontal bar with hole, and target wall using creator_lib
add_dynamic_ball: create a dynamic ball object in the PHYRE scene with a specified scale and position
add_static_bar: create a static bar obstacle in the PHYRE scene with configurable scale, angle, and position
update_task_goal: define the PHYRE task goal by setting body1, body2, and their required spatial relationship
set_solution_tier: set the PHYRE task metadata to specify the solution tier such as PRE_TWO_BALLS
